payload.title: Claude Code adapter
payload.description:
Purpose: extract human-authored messages from Claude Code session transcripts at ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session>.jsonl.

Scope: discovery (path encoding replaces non-alphanumeric characters with dashes, paths over 200 chars truncated plus a hash; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR support; history archive roots; subagent transcripts excluded); extraction of real user-typed messages (user-type records, plus queued command attachments with human origin) with rejection of injected content (tool results, system reminders, task notifications, interrupted-request markers, compact-summary continuations, slash-command envelopes, sidechains); session and project attribution from sessionId/cwd; dedup across forked/branched session copies and duplicate copies in archive roots; incremental re-scan via append-only watermarks; doctor checks for format drift. Format claims cite the official Claude Code session docs; the docs warn the JSONL entry format is internal and changes between versions, so parsing must be tolerant.

Done when: golden extraction tests pass on synthetic fixtures (messages, exclusions, queued commands, dedup, attribution); a rescan after appending to a transcript yields identical totals to a cold scan; doctor reports on a real Mac's roots; unverifiable format assumptions have been checked against a real Mac and recorded as findings.
